g.text: Gateway up + Open Notebook pod healthy
Open Notebook called the model through the gateway
pi called the model through the gateway
cmd: just harness-compare | pass: prints 'open-notebook: healthy' and the gateway answers GET /v1/models 200
cmd: just harness-compare | pass: prints 'open-notebook: model test success=True' and a gateway record 'POST /v1/chat/completions 200'
cmd: just harness-compare | pass: prints 'pi: delegate rc=0' and a gateway record 'POST /v1/chat/completions 200'
cmd: just harness-compare | pass: prints 'difference: only-open-notebook=... only-pi=...' then 'PASS harness-compare'
cmd: just harness-compare | pass: podman pod ps lists no wattson-open-notebook and podman ps lists no wattson-gateway
